cause.repin_2026_09_04: RE-PINNED 2026-09-04, 151326 to 351480. First causal change: d2279ea3, the equation-world commit, which made the cache an image a Prolog codec validates and decodes rather than a term fast_read/2 consumes whole. Measured on a 2,000-equation cache before this pass: validating 264,121 inferences, decoding 116,011, against 270,105 for the storing that is the work. Reduced here from 831,560 to 351,480 by fusing three full walks into one and skipping the decode outright: the validity pass walked every term for space references, then walked the WHOLE image again for host objects, then the decode walked it a third time rebuilding every node to swap references a program with no child space does not have. The one walk now answers all three questions and reports whether any reference exists, and `none` skips the decode. What is left is one walk of an untrusted payload, which the format requires and cannot be skipped on a file the engine did not write. STILL LINEAR: the walk is O(atoms), nrms 1.19e-05 against the linear model, which is why the family is unchanged and only the constant moved.
